titulo: Recurrent thymoma-associated PRCA with persistent agranulocytosis: a case report and therapeutic considerations

fig.label: Figure 1
fig.caption: Clinical, morphologic, imaging, and hematologic findings in the present case. (A) Bone marrow smears obtained on February 24 and February 26, 2025. (B) Contrast-enhanced and noncontrast chest CT demonstrating the recurrent anterior mediastinal lesion consistent with thymoma. (C) Serial changes in white blood cell count (WBC) and absolute neutrophil count (ANC) during follow-up, together with granulocyte colony-stimulating factor (G-CSF) administration and cyclosporine A (CsA) treatment/exposure. (D) Serial changes in hemoglobin (Hb) and absolute reticulocyte count during follow-up.
